# Car loan

Buying the 2021 MG ZS EV, August 2025. Hate debt, but the numbers made sense once the Astra was sold and the petrol stopped. Writing down how I compared everything because the dealer finance bloke was slippery.

## The car

- 2021 MG ZS EV Exclusive, 31,400 miles, one owner, full MG history
- Dealer: Avon Valley Motors, Keynsham. Salesman: Craig Fennimore
- Advertised £13,995, got it to £13,495 after pointing out two kerbed alloys and a missing second key
- Checked MOT history online (passed every year, one advisory for a wiper blade) and did an HPI-style check, £9.99, cert HP-55190-ZS, clear: no outstanding finance, not written off, mileage consistent
- Battery state of health report from the dealer's scan: 94%

## The money side

- Price: £13,495
- Part-ex: none, sold the Astra privately for £1,650 (see [[Selling the old hatchback]])
- Deposit: £3,500 from savings. Kept the rest of the [[Emergency fund]] untouched, that was the rule
- To borrow: £9,995

## Options compared

### Dealer HP (hire purchase)

- 9.9% APR representative, 48 months
- Monthly: £252.40, total payable £12,115 plus £10 option-to-purchase fee
- Craig kept talking about "only £252 a month" and never the total. Asked three times for the total amount payable before he'd say it

### Dealer PCP

- Lower monthly (£189) but a £5,100 balloon at the end. No point, I keep cars until they die

### Personal loan, Zopa

- 7.4% APR, 48 months, £9,995
- Monthly: £240.71
- Total payable: £11,554.08
- Own the car from day one, which matters if anything goes wrong with the dealer
- Soft search first, so no hit on the credit file till I applied

### Bristol Credit Union

- 8.9% APR, they were nice but slower, 2 weeks for a decision

## What I picked

Zopa personal loan. Agreement ref ZP-LN-6620374, drawn 4 Aug 2025, first payment 1 Sept 2025, 48 payments, last one 1 Aug 2029. Paid the dealer by bank transfer the same day, picked up 6 Aug.

Saved about £560 over the HP in total, plus I own the car outright.

## Overpaying

Zopa lets you overpay without a fee. Plan is an extra £100 a month whenever there's a good month from overtime. If I keep that up it's paid off in roughly 3 years, not 4. Same logic as [[Mortgage overpayment]], smaller scale.

## Budget impact

| Line | Before (Astra) | After (MG) |
|---|---|---|
| Fuel/charging | £148 | £22 |
| Loan | £0 | £240.71 |
| Insurance | £39 | £54 |
| Road tax | £16.25 | £16.25 (EVs pay VED since Apr 2025) |
| Servicing (monthly avg) | £45 | £15 |

Net roughly £100 a month more than the Astra, for a car that isn't about to fall apart. Logged in [[Budget spreadsheet]].

## Lessons

- Always ask for the total amount payable, not the monthly
- Get your own finance sorted before walking into the dealer, then they can't play with the numbers
- Insurance quote before signing anything, the MG was a higher group than I guessed
